title: Russia Strikes Ukraine Overnight with Kinzhal Missile + 147 Drones — 138 Intercepted, Hits at 7 Locations
detail: Overnight into May 28, 2026 (Day 1,554), Russia launched one Kh-47 Kinzhal aeroballistic missile (from a MiG-31K over Lipetsk Oblast airspace) and 147 attack UAVs — including Shahed, Herber/Geran, Italmas, and jet-powered variants — from multiple directions: Bryansk, Kursk, Oryol, Millerovo, and Primorsko-Akhtarsk in Russia, plus Hvardiiske and Chauda in occupied Crimea. Ukrainian air defense forces — deploying aircraft, anti-aircraft missile systems, electronic warfare, and mobile fire groups — destroyed 138 of 147 drones (93.9% interception rate). The Kinzhal missile was not intercepted. Nine drones also breached defenses. Strikes were confirmed at 7 locations; drone debris fell at 6 additional locations. The attack continues Russia's near-nightly drone campaign, which has averaged 100–300 UAVs per night throughout May 2026.

media.caption: Russia launches Kinzhal missile and 147 attack drones overnight into May 28 — 138 UAVs downed, Kinzhal not intercepted, hits at 7 locations

title: Russian MLRS Strike Kills Father at Kherson Children's Playground, Critically Wounds Wife and Two Daughters (Ages 3 and 6)
detail: On May 27–28, 2026, Russian forces struck a children's playground in Kherson city's Korabelny district using multiple-launch rocket systems (MLRS/artillery) from Russian-controlled positions on the east (left) bank of the Dnipro River. A father in his 30s was killed. His wife (36) and two young daughters — aged 3 and 6 — were seriously wounded: the 3-year-old was in critical condition and was evacuated to Mykolaiv for emergency surgery to remove shrapnel from her head; the 6-year-old sustained shrapnel wounds to the back and required surgery. A 50-year-old man in the vicinity was also wounded. The attack on a civilian playground constitutes a potential war crime under International Humanitarian Law. Kherson city has been under near-daily Russian artillery, rocket, and drone attack since its liberation in November 2022, when Russian forces withdrew to the left bank and began shelling the city systematically.

media.caption: Russian MLRS strike kills father and critically wounds mother and two young daughters (ages 3 and 6) at children's playground in Kherson's Korabelny district

title: Zelensky Visits Sweden: 16 Gripen C/D Jets Donated + 20 Gripen E/F Purchase Deal Signed (€2.5 Billion)
detail: On May 28, 2026, President Zelensky traveled to Stockholm for talks with Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson. Sweden announced it will donate 16 JAS 39 Gripen C/D multi-role fighter jets from its active air force fleet, along with advanced ammunition, with deliveries expected to begin in early 2027. Ukraine also agreed to purchase up to 20 next-generation Gripen E/F fighters using €2.5 billion (~$2.9 billion) from an EU support loan, with delivery expected before 2030. The deal makes Sweden one of the most significant contributors of air power to Ukraine's defense. Zelensky also promoted Ukraine's drone warfare expertise as an export capability. Sweden joined NATO in March 2024 and has been one of the top Western military aid providers per capita. The Gripen jets will supplement Ukraine's F-16 fleet (donated by Belgium, Denmark, Netherlands, Norway) and significantly expand Ukrainian air force capacity.

media.caption: Zelensky visits Sweden May 28: Stockholm donates 16 Gripen C/D jets and agrees to sell up to 20 Gripen E/F fighters for €2.5 billion from EU loan funds

title: Ukrainian General Staff: 1,160 Russian Soldiers Killed or Wounded — Cumulative Losses Reach ~1,360,110
detail: Ukraine's General Staff reported on May 28, 2026 (Day 1,554 of Russia's full-scale invasion) that approximately 1,160 Russian soldiers were killed and wounded in the preceding 24 hours — a spike from the 1,000 reported on May 27. Cumulative Russian military personnel losses since February 24, 2022 reached approximately 1,360,110. The daily loss rate has averaged over 1,000+ through May 2026, with Commander-in-Chief Syrskyi confirming 141,500+ total Russian losses in 2026 alone (83,000+ irreversible). Ukraine's General Staff also reported 232 combat engagements over the previous day, with the heaviest fighting concentrated on the Pokrovsk, Kostiantynivka, and Huliaipole axes. Russia's rate of advance has declined from 9.76 sq km/day (early 2025) to approximately 2.9 sq km/day in May 2026, per ISW analysis.

media.caption: Ukrainian General Staff: 1,160 Russian soldiers killed or wounded May 28 — cumulative losses reach ~1,360,110 since Feb 24, 2022

title: Zelensky Submits €90 Billion EU Support Loan Ratification Bill to Verkhovna Rada
detail: On May 28, 2026, President Zelensky submitted bill No. 0376 to Ukraine's Verkhovna Rada (parliament) for ratification of the EU-Ukraine Support Loan agreement totaling €90 billion for 2026–2027. The package comprises €16.7 billion for the state budget and €28.3 billion for defense needs — the largest single EU financial commitment to Ukraine since the start of the full-scale invasion. The €2.5 billion Gripen E/F jet purchase agreement signed with Sweden the same day draws on this EU loan. The loan package was unblocked after Hungary's election changed Budapest's blocking posture toward EU Ukraine aid. Ratification by the Rada formalizes the legal framework for disbursement.

media.caption: Zelensky submits €90B EU loan ratification bill (No. 0376) to Verkhovna Rada — €28.3B for defense, €16.7B for budget, part of 2026-2027 EU support package
